purpose: Reproducible, owner-gated deployment and verification recipe for Pantheon's managed native-CLI display-power denial guard. It is deployment tooling, not a product payload or a substitute for the durable in-process custody gate.

authority.root_deployment_owner: Hardware system administrator through an explicit owner-approved sudo transaction
prohibited: do not execute this recipe implicitly or from a product UI
do not claim desktop-session tool-bridge or OS-wide coverage
do not run Studio tests, display-power operations, reboot, or settings changes as part of installation

inputs: an exact SHA-256 bound sirsi-pretoolguard executable
the exact managed requirements policy bytes
a root-owned /etc/codex directory and an explicit owner-approved sudo transaction
an inert fake-pmset native CLI verification fixture
outputs: a root-owned managed PreToolUse policy preserving existing user lifecycle hooks
a native CLI denial for direct display-power routes before execution
an idempotent no-change result when identical safe artifacts are already installed
an explicit limitation that desktop-session tool bridging requires a separate Ra integration
upgrade_recipe: build and independently verify the exact guard binary before any root transaction
preserve the pinned policy bytes and refuse symlinks, non-root ownership, writable root artifacts, or conflicting existing bytes
preserve existing user hooks by omitting allow_managed_hooks_only
verify the native CLI with an inert fake executable; never use real pmset as a canary
treat native CLI success as narrow coverage and route desktop tool-bridge enforcement to Ra
keep this Python installer outside product payloads and package inventory
